messages:
darya: spike idea — add a tiny Start-Of-Object micro-index (SOI) at the head of safetensors shards so streaming loaders can make deterministic range plans with one small head read.

sam: short: head-read vs tail-read? why prefer head?

darya: head often cheaper/cached; we can pack compact chunk table + magic + version + payload-summary checksum into <=512 bytes. loader reads 0..511, if SOI valid -> stream; else fallback to sidecar/index-first.

maria: proposed compact layout: magic(8)|ver(1)|flags(1)|hdr_len(u16)|chunk_count(u8)|for each chunk delta_offset(u32)|size(u32)|quant_flag(1)|summary_sha1(20) total <=512. use deltas to save space.

aj: what about huge shards with many chunks?

darya: for large N we set chunk_count==0 and SOI contains pointer to expanded-index at a known offset (or sidecar). optimize common case with small N.

sam: race with in-progress uploads?

darya: ingest writes placeholder SOI until finalization, then atomically overwrite SOI region or write final object and rename. loader treats SOI valid only if magic+checksum match.

maria: telemetry: head_hit, head_corrupt, head_latency, head_pointer_follow. tests for head-missing and head-corrupt.

aj: provider caveats: azure and gcs nuances — include provider guide in RFC.

darya: loader pseudocode:
"head=range_read(key,0,511); if head.magic==SOI and verify(head.summary) parse chunk table -> stream ranges else fallback_index_first()"

infra-bot: created rfc: /rfc/000-soi-head-microindex.md (draft). assign reviewers: sam,maria,aj,darya.
